scientific_limitations: Asymptotics apply to fixed source probabilities strictly between zero and one; dependent on the published Mahonian local limit theorem. No uniform endpoint limit, and no claim to have invented the known Gaussian-binomial class-count formula.
title: Sharp two-source collision law for binary scattered-pair profiles
